description: This file defines an interface 'ShareeListAdapterListener' which declares methods related to sharing actions in the Android client application of Nextcloud Notes, including copying links, sharing menus, permissions dialogs, and profile display.

classes.name: ShareeListAdapterListener
classes.description: An interface for handling sharing-related user interactions within the app.

methods.name: showSharingMenuActionSheet
methods.description: Displays the sharing options menu for the provided OCShare.

methods.name: copyInternalLink
methods.description: Copies an internal link (details not specified).

methods.name: createPublicShareLink
methods.description: Creates a new public sharing link.

methods.name: createSecureFileDrop
methods.description: Creates a secure file drop, details depend on implementation.

methods.name: requestPasswordForShare
methods.description: Requests a password for the given OCShare, optionally asking the user.

methods.name: showPermissionsDialog
methods.description: Displays the permissions dialog for the provided OCShare.

methods.name: showProfileBottomSheet
methods.description: Shows a profile bottom sheet for the specified account and share recipient.
